segments.text: 23 But haſt lift thy ſelfe vp agaynſt the Lord of heauen, and they haue brought the veſſels of his houſe before thee, and thou and thy princes, thy wiues and thy concubines haue dronke wine in them, and thou haſt prayſed the Gods of ſiluer, and gold, of braſſe, yron, wood, and ſtone, which neither ſee, neither heare, neither vnderſtand: and the God in whoſe hand thy breath is and all thy wayes, him haſt thou not glorified.
